desc: Pick an army in the Battle for Middle-earth — Free Peoples of Middle-earth, Forces of the Dark Lord or Mercenaries.
h_60s: The most important things in 60 seconds
s60_l1: Choose your army by atmosphere, but also by what costume you can prepare.
s60_l2: Every participant has a costume duty for the whole event.
s60_l3: The costume doesn’t have to be perfect, but it must be thematic and non-distracting.
s60_l4: Weapons must be safe, approved and visually fitting for the world of Middle-earth.

s60_l7: If you don’t want to fight, you can come as non-combatant escort, atmospheric character, photographer, helper or parent.

merc_p: Mercenaries are a neutral side — during the event they may be assigned to either the Free Peoples or the Forces of the Dark Lord depending on what is needed to balance the fighting and the story.
tt_h: The camp will live by armies
tt_p_pre: We want armies to be more than a colour on the battlefield. Armies will have their own camp life, space for trade, services, roleplay and small tasks. For 2026 we want the campsite to be more divided by armies and sides — the dividing line naturally runs between
roles_p: You don’t want to fight but want to be part of Middle-earth? There are several roles that are an essential part of the event.
role_t_hobiti: Second breakfast, a pipe and a different point of view.
role_d_hobiti: An atmospheric role for innkeepers, traders, stallholders, NPCs and observers of the action. Hobbits don’t fight, but they are the heart of the campsite and the market.
role_l_hobiti_3: suitable for the inn, market, NPC roles,
role_t_escort: You’re in the game, helping the atmosphere, but you don’t fight.
role_d_escort: Combatant escorts, sutlers, banner-bearers, craftspeople, messengers, camp roles or atmospheric characters.
role_l_escort_4: arrangement with the army or organisers.
role_t_photog: Capturing the story yes. Getting in the way of the game no.
role_d_photog: Photographers and videographers must comply with the costume duty and movement rules in the play space.
role_t_stalls: Crafts, market and things for Middle-earth.
role_d_stalls: Sellers of costumes, fabrics, leather accessories, jewellery, LARP weapons and other thematic gear. The stall is part of the market and the campsite.
role_l_stalls_2: staffing in costume or unobtrusive clothing,
role_t_helpers: Without you the camp wouldn’t stand. Without us, neither.
role_d_helpers_pre: We’re looking for people who want to help with organisation — registration, weapon checks, the children’s game, camp programme, facilities. The reward is usually
role_d_helpers_post: , good vibes and the respect of the community.
role_l_helpers_2: you can help with a specific area,
role_l_helpers_3: write to us in advance about what you enjoy,
role_d_orgs: The team that prepares, organises and runs the whole weekend. You’ll find contacts, team roles and a few words about the people who make it all happen.
role_l_orgs_1: you cannot sign up to be an organiser,
role_l_orgs_2: the team is built by long-term agreement,
role_l_orgs_4: want to be more involved in the community? Get in touch.
kids_t: An adventure for younger participants who don’t yet belong in the main battle.
kids_p1_pre: The main game and battle participation is for participants
kids_p1_post: . For younger children we run a separate children’s game, which has its own rhythm, an appropriate level of difficulty and a safer way to take part.
kids_p2: The children’s game runs separately from the main battle and is for children who want to live their own story in Middle-earth.
